content.text:
I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. It type-checks with no errors in that file and bundles to 313 bytes (min+gzip), with 95 bytes of your own code. The original's 4 type errors in `src/module.ts` come from lodash not being installed, not from the migration. I didn't run the equivalence check against the original's outputs.

| lodash | es-toolkit | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `mapValues(scores, fn)` | `mapValues` from `es-toolkit` | Same call shape. |
| `keyBy(rows, 'name')` | `keyBy` from `es-toolkit` | Strict `keyBy` takes only a function, not the `'name'` shorthand. I wrapped the call as `keyBy(rows, (row) => row.name)`. |
| `fromPairs(pairs)` | `fromPairs` from `es-toolkit/compat` | Strict es-toolkit has no `fromPairs`; only compat does. |

The exported signatures (`doubled`, `byNameKey`, `toLookup`) and the `Row` and `Config` types are unchanged, and no lodash import remains.

`Object.fromEntries` would be smaller (232 bytes), but I kept compat `fromPairs` because you asked for es-toolkit functions where one exists. If you'd rather use the built-in, it's a one-line swap.

Docs: https://es-toolkit.dev/reference/object/mapValues.html and https://es-toolkit.dev/reference/array/keyBy.html
